notes.title: Patch Notes #2
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

First of all, a huge thank you to everyone playing and enjoying Nomad Defender! Your support and feedback mean the world to us.

Today, we’re releasing a new update focused on bug fixes and key improvements to enhance your gameplay experience.

[hr][/hr]

Bug Fixing

 Hand Cards Breaking: Fixed a critical issue where players couldn’t select any cards from their hand, causing them to lose the run.
 Ignored Enemies : Fixed an issue where turrets would sometimes ignore enemies with low health.
 Card Animations: Fixed animations not playing correctly when a card’s cost was increased or decreased.
Typos: Corrected minor grammar errors in various in-game texts.



[hr][/hr]

Improvements

 Enemy Targetting: Previously, turrets would immediately re-target when they lost sight of their current enemy. Now, turrets will wait until they are about to fire before choosing a new target, prioritizing the enemy closest to their node. This change should reduce frustrating moments where turrets didn’t target the expected enemy.
Updated Victory Animation: The victory screen now has an improved animation for a more satisfying win experience.
Redraws System: Added card blacklisting when redrawing cards at the start of a Tower Defense battle, ensuring better deck control.


[hr][/hr]

That’s all for now!
We’ll keep you updated with any future news. In the meantime, enjoy the game—we’re always listening to your feedback to keep improving Nomad Defender!

P.S. Oh, and if you’re reading this but don’t own Nomad Defender yet… the discount ends later today! Maybe now’s the perfect time to grab it... 

See you next time!

– The Dhelpra Games Team

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Yeah, we know—technically, it’s a Day 2 Patch… but if we count launch day as Day 0, then today is Day 1, and if there’s a patch on Day 1, well… it’s a Day 1 Patch :)

After release, we’ve been closely gathering feedback on your experience with Nomad Defender. Thanks to you, we noticed some bugs and certain levels or difficulties that were way tougher than intended.

We’ve been working hard on these fixes, and now they’re live! Here’s what’s changed:

[hr][/hr]

Balancing


 Orbiting Projectile Buff: 65% -> 80% damage per hit.
 Hard difficulty slightly decreased: All enemies now have -5% health and armor.
 Slightly decreased boss fight difficulty.
 Decreased difficulty on some mid and late levels: Changed some placing tiles and balanced certain enemy waves.

[hr][/hr]

Bug Fixes


 Sometimes data wasn't saved correctly when closing the game.
 The "Perfect Defense" Highscore wasn't working as it should.
 Sometimes selecting an upgrade room would crash the game
 The "\searchingPerfectiont" could be achieved by losing the first battle.


[hr][/hr]

Thank you!

That said, we want to thank you for all the support we are receiving after the release.

If you grabbed Nomad Defender and think it was worth your while, consider leaving a positive review to help us with visibility so more people can enjoy this game!
Thank you again and see you until next time.

The Dhelpra Games Team 🦊

notes.title: 🎮 Steam Next Fest has started! 🎮
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’re back, and this time we’re celebrating Steam Next Fest! 🎉

With so many new players discovering Nomad Defender, we wanted to give you a quick rundown of what you’ll find in the demo. Whether you’re jumping in for the first time or returning to the battlefield, here’s what’s waiting for you!

And if you’re wondering what’s coming in the full version, we’ve got you covered—Nomad Defender launches on March 10th! Keep reading to find out what’s in store. 👇

[hr][/hr]

 ⚔️ Everything About the Demo 


 🏰 Lots of Levels to Conquer 
Like any great roguelike, every run should feel fresh! That’s why we’ve expanded the level pool— unique layouts will appear randomly throughout your journey, making each run a new strategic challenge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/5000b08bfe1fc6c3fc0bded326a123a26444b712.gif



 ♟️+25 Different Projectiles and Abilities
We want every run to feel unique and strategic. With a huge variety of projectiles, turret abilities, and passive synergies, you’ll need to experiment and adapt if you want to survive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/358ba483f55f7da9ed92646d040fb3781c4c6692.gif


[hr][/hr]


 🎉 Nomad Defender Releases March 10th  
Steam Next Fest is just the beginning! Once the event ends, you won’t have to wait long—Nomad Defender launches on March 10th! But what’s coming in the full release? Let’s break it down! 👇


 🏙️ More Levels & Late-Stage Battles 
The demo lets you experience 2 Early-Stage levels and 1 Mid-Stage battle, but the full game will push you even further. Late-stage battles will introduce larger, more challenging maps to test your skills.


 😈 Hard Difficulty Mode 
Thought the demo was too easy? 
We’ve been tweaking difficulty to make Hard Mode a real test of skill. It’s so challenging that you’ll need to complete a Normal run first to unlock it. Good luck—you’ll need it. 😉


 🚨 (Spoiler Alert!) [spoiler] Boss Fight Incoming [/spoiler]
That’s right—[spoiler]a boss fight[/spoiler] is coming! 
Every great challenge needs an epic finale, and we’re making sure it’s as intense as it gets. We won’t spoil the details, but prepare for a battle that will push your strategy to the limit.


 💥 More Abilities 
Think you’ve mastered all the synergies? Think again! The full game will introduce even more powerful abilities to combine with your turrets.


 🃏 New Starter Decks 
A solid strategy starts before the battle begins! The full version will include two new Starter Decks, giving you more ways to tailor your build right from the start. Each deck comes with unique turrets, passives, and support buildings for even deeper strategic choices.


 🏆 Achievements 
What’s a roguelike without achievements? Prove your mastery and unlock special achievements as you conquer the battlefield!


[hr][/hr]

 And that's all! 
Thanks for passing by, hope you are as much hyped as we are for this fest and the upcoming release.
Give a try to the Demo and let us know what you think! Your feedback is crucial for making the final version even better.

Thanks for your support!
- The Dhelpra Games Team 🦊

notes.title: 🚨 Demo Update! 🚨
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while since our last update, but we've been work hard improving Nomad Defender! 
Today, we’re excited to share new content and major improvements in the demo – now available to play!

Let’s dive into what’s new! 👇

[hr][/hr]

 📝 New Upgrade Room: Copy Ability

Ever added the perfect ability to the wrong card? Or wished you could duplicate an overpowered ability across multiple cards?

Well, now you can! This new Upgrade Room lets you replicate an ability from one card to another, giving you more control over your strategy. 

Build synergies, optimize your deck, and create devastating combos!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/358ba483f55f7da9ed92646d040fb3781c4c6692.gif

[hr][/hr]

 😈 New Enemies 

More challenges await! Get ready to face new threats on the battlefield, each with unique abilities that will test your strategy:


Minion Egg – A moving transporter that carries enemies inside. Once destroyed, it releases its hidden reinforcements onto the battlefield.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/efe84319a6b46d59c683ee2c2a13c3865b98d68e.gif


Dasher – Your worst nightmare when paired with fast enemies… It dashes through the level, making it difficult to keep within your turrets' range. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/dbf3652cee79cc9396420c6f68146d0d30650a6d.gif


Mega Tank – The toughest enemy yet. Taking it down will require serious firepower. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/616816b01045f1613430448fefd7400c2ca58e73.gif

 
And more! (But we won’t spoil everything… for now)

[hr][/hr]

 🌆 More and better Levels 

We took a hard look at our levels and made them more engaging, diverse, and fair. Some received layout tweaks, while others were completely redesigned for better pacing and balance.

🔥 New TD levels have been added for Early & Mid Stages! (Late-stage levels? You’ll have to wait for the full release… 😈)

And finally… Levels are no longer empty! We’ve filled them with more environmental details to enhance immersion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/5000b08bfe1fc6c3fc0bded326a123a26444b712.gif

[hr][/hr]

 🚥Difficulty Selector 

We’ve always envisioned Nomad Defender as a Tower Defense game for everyone, but through development and playtesting, we realized it’s more complex than we initially thought.

To improve accessibility while maintaining the challenge, we’ve introduced a Difficulty Selector. Here’s how it works:

🟢 Easy – Perfect for players new to Tower Defense & Deckbuilders.
🟡 Normal – Designed for those experienced in the genre.
🔴 Hard (Locked in Demo) – A true hardcore challenge for strategic masterminds.

Now, whether you're here for the strategy or the chaos, you can tailor the experience to your style! 
In which difficulty are you gonna play?

[hr][/hr]
And that's a wrap!
We hope you enjoy everything this new demo update has to offer. 
Try it out and let us know your thoughts—we’d love to hear your feedback!

Next stop… Steam Next Fest on February 24th! 🚀
We’ve been keeping some exciting surprises under wraps for the full release, and we can’t wait to share them with you there.

Until then, enjoy the demo!

Thank you for your support - see you next time!
– The Dhelpra Games Team 🦊

notes.title: 🚀 New Demo Coming Soon! 🚀
notes.content:
Later this month, we’ll be dropping an updated demo for Nomad Defender! Over the past couple of months, the team has been hard at work improving everything — from gameplay and balance to visuals. Here’s a sneak peek at what’s new:

[hr][/hr]

🛠️ Passives Revamped

We’ve redesigned the passive system, making the game more scalable. Now, you can equip up to 3 passives per turret, allowing for deeper synergies. With this change, we’ve replaced the Base Replacement upgrade rooms with Passive Upgrade Rooms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/8aafed308daf63e6c7f3ccafeae32eddf869f725.gif

[hr][/hr]

🔥 Projectile Overhaul
To offer players more freedom without compromising the experience, we’ve revamped projectiles. Now, projectiles determine both how how they travel towards enemies (straight shot, more like a shotgun, etc) and what they do upon impact (jump between enemies, pierce through them, etc.).

For example, the Zap projectile (now called “Chaining”) can jump between enemies, but no longer stuns them—stun is now a passive that can be applied to any projectile.

[hr][/hr]

💥 New Projectiles

These changes pave the way for new strategies. In the upcoming demo, you’ll get to try two new projectiles:
Orbiting and Shotgun — each offering unique ways to take down enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/b282e424c484bc4234e3b44e059b56e9582fe5eb.gif

[hr][/hr]

🎨 New Card Visuals

With the changes to how cards work, we’ve improved their design to better communicate all the new information. Plus, we’ve given them a fresh, cooler look that we think you’ll love!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/a644fa1d138a62c4ba8302c33ead67c9a3e73455.gif

[hr][/hr]

That’s all for now! We hope you like the new ideas we’ve shared with you.
Until then, stay updated by following us on our social media:

- Twitter
- Instagram


Thanks for your support, see you next time!

- The Dhelpra Games Team

notes.title: 💥Nomad Defender Demo Update (V.0.2.)💥
notes.content:
What you will find in the Demo Update (V.0.2.)


🪙 Economy System Redesign! 🪙{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/716d18659c3d3c4e0f305111138ef53faab6c568.gif
In this update, we've overhauled the economy system. Now, you earn 20 currency every 5 seconds during TD fights, instead of getting currency from each defeated enemy. This change allows for better planning and strategic decision-making!




 🃏 New Upgrade 🃏
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/fd9665708deeb394f8397ff22af31b86198b18b3.gif
We're expanding Nomad Defender with new systems and mechanics to enhance your card's power throughout the run. In Bonus Stats upgrade you can permanently enhance the stats of your cards permanently during that run.




 💀 R.I.P. Body Replacement 💀
In order to keep strategic depth, we've removed the Body Replacement upgrade, which allowed swapping turret bodies. In its place, we've added the Bonus Stats upgrade to ensure more thoughtful gameplay.




 ✍️ More Narrative ✍️ 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/35dea3cb9873fb46000cb202fdeff7462a21af7e.gif
Nomad Defender isn't just about strategy; it's also about a story. Discover more of the secrets lurking in the shadows in this update.




🎨7 New Levels🎨
We've added 7 new levels to challenge you, tailored to different stages of your run:
 3 Early levels of 1 node.
 2 Early levels of 2 nodes
 1 Mid level of 1 nodes
 1 Mid level of 2 nodes





⚡Improved tutorial⚡
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773997/c465d8ed1378529ada3aebeb0b529a0e4e22ab37.gif
We haveve listened to your feedback and we have improved the tutorial. It's now almost twice as fast to complete and more self-explanatory than ever!
